summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the exchange of its existing Senior Secured Convertible Note due 2028 (initial $74M, outstanding $46.86M) for a new Senior Secured Convertible Note due 2027 ($16.86M) and a new Senior Secured Term Note due 2028 ($30M) via an Omnibus Amendment and Exchange Agreement with one current lender and an institutional investor. The transaction closed on July 1, 2026. This debt restructuring reduces near-term convertible obligations. No board recommendation or advisors were disclosed. Watch for potential dilution from conversion features and liquidity improvement from the extended maturity profile.
